subpageUsage: Same Hero component as the homepage, switched into its feature-detail (.hero-wowh) branch by props rather than an explicit `variant` prop: `eyebrow` set (green-chip Eyebrow replaces the avatar strip + social-proof line), `showBadges={false}` (no review-badge row; the buttons follow the subtitle's 20px bottom margin), `subtitleTone="grey"`, `secondaryVariant="dark"` (44px dark button) and a labelled product-UI placeholder at a per-route aspect (default 1440/1289). Used by all 17 /lms/features/* routes via src/pages/features/FeatureDetail.jsx with per-route copy from featureDetailData.js; the CTA labels are constant across routes. Layout per breakpoint is identical to the homepage branch (two columns with the visual bleeding -30vw past the right edge; stacks at <=767; buttons stack full width at <=479).
evidenceNotes: There is no `variant` prop on Hero; the feature-detail branch is selected by passing `eyebrow` (truthy) plus showBadges={false}. The merge's `variant: "feature-detail"` const is a contract-level discriminator only.
Hero.jsx still exposes `eyebrowChipClassName` but FeatureDetail.jsx never passes it, so every feature route uses the default bg-green-hover chip.
Only two Hero usages exist in src/pages (Home.jsx and FeatureDetail.jsx); no other subpage uses this component.
Longest real instances computed over all 17 FEATURE_DETAIL entries: eyebrow 3 ('AI Course Creator'), title 13 (/lms/features/mcp), subtitle 36 (/lms/features/lms-admin).
